findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "relationships" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: astroway_agent_tools, astroway_mcp_rag_search · Private data: astroway_account_status, astroway_agent_tools, astroway_relational_synastry_attraction_score, astroway_rel_synastry_attraction_score · Public sink: astroway_mcp_ai_chat, astroway_mcp_ai_comparison_coach, astroway_mcp_ai_explain_aspect, astroway_mcp_ai_explain_transit, astroway_relational_coalescent, astroway_relational_composite, astroway_relational_davison, astroway_family_genogram, astroway_family_parent_child_deep, astroway_family_saturn_return_cycles, astroway_family_sibling_dynamics, astroway_family_system_pattern, astroway_relational_group_synastry, astroway_relational_match_score, astroway_mcp_agent_debate, astroway_mcp_multi_agent_coordinate, astroway_mcp_multi_chart_context, astroway_mcp_rag_search, astroway_mcp_streaming, astroway_mcp_tool_call_stream, astroway_pet_best_names, astroway_pet_birth_chart, astroway_pet_communication_style, astroway_pet_diet_by_sign, astroway_pet_exercise_needs, astroway_pet_grooming_by_element, astroway_pet_health_tips, astroway_pet_lucky_day, astroway_pet_owner_pet_compatibility, astroway_pet_personality, astroway_pet_play_style, astroway_pet_sun_sign_meaning, astroway_pet_temperament, astroway_pet_training_style, astroway_relational_synastry, astroway_relational_synastry_aspect_grid, astroway_relational_synastry_attraction_score, astroway_rel_synastry_attraction_score, astroway_relational_synastry_element_balance, astroway_relational_synastry_house_overlay · Destructive: astroway_account_status, astroway_agent_tools, astroway_mcp_multi_agent_coordinate.
